modalities.evidence: Extracting decision spans from clinical notes
discharge summaries in the MIMIC-III database

output.population: 451 expert-annotated discharge summaries in the MIMIC-III database, spanning eleven diverse patient phenotypes
output.summary: Expert annotations of ten types of medical decisions marked as character spans in MIMIC-III discharge summaries, spanning diverse patient phenotypes, supporting extraction and classification of decisions in clinical notes.
